content: Yes, that is correct. In Switzerland, mandatory health insurance (LaMal) is required for all residents, and the rule you mentioned is indeed accurate. You can sign up for basic health insurance after three months of residence in Switzerland without any disadvantages or penalties. There are no restrictions on enrolling later if you were previously uninsured. However, it is important to note that health insurance in Switzerland is mandatory, and failure to obtain coverage can result in fines.
